## Why This Is Asked

This question probes practical CAPA thinking for a real-world data-exposure risk in multi-tenant systems, focusing on beginner-friendly design while requiring concrete artifacts.

## Key Concepts

- CAPA data modeling for root cause, containment, and prevention
- Lifecycle/state machine for tracking progress
- Minimal REST API design for CAPA creation and updates
- Region/tenant-aware metrics to prove containment
- RCA templates and canary-based remediation planning
